description: What the interface is allowed to ask the host for. Every command EON Stream defines is in commands.rs and is enumerated there; this file covers the host's built-in surface, and it is deliberately the smallest set the window needs. It applies to both webviews in the window: the catalogue, and the player's controls laid over mpv while something plays -- the same commands, nothing more. No plugin is enabled: no file system, no shell, no HTTP from the frontend. The interface reaches the network only through the commands below, which is what keeps an addon's address -- and the credential it can carry -- on this side of the line.
